summary_1line: Bhima captures and humiliates Jayadratha for abducting Draupadi; he is spared, performs penance to Shiva, and receives a boon to briefly check the Pandavas except Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima leaps from his chariot, grabs the fleeing Jayadratha by the hair, and hurls him violently to the ground in the forest.
Bhima shaves Jayadratha’s head leaving five tufts while the defeated king kneels in dust and chains before the Pandavas.
The god Shiva appears before the penitent Jayadratha performing severe austerities on the lonely bank where the Ganga meets the plains.
